newsitem.title: UK: Japanese stocks in London steady ahead trade data.
newsitem.headline: Japanese stocks in London steady ahead trade data.

text.p: Japanese shares closed steady in London on Tuesday on investor caution ahead of Japan's trade figures, traders said.
The Nikkei 50 index was up 1.15 points at 1,610.07.
In Tokyo, the Nikkei 225 had finished 87.41 points lower at 20,593.66 points.
"(It was) a fairly dull day. Tokyo is waiting for the trade figures and so are we", a trader said.

Export-orientated companies eased as the yen firmed against the dollar, he said. The dollar will slip further if the Japanese trade surplus against the U.S. widens, thus sending the stocks downwards, he forecast.
Hitachi shares were down 10 yen to 1,290 yen, while Sony shed 110 yen to close at 9,770 yen. This compared with a close at 9,800 yen in Tokyo.
Among the banks, Sumitomo Bank was down 67.50 yen to 1,776 yen on news of pending bad loans.
